title: Case Analysis Method & Discovery — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Compliance & Cost Trade-off Conflict: demonstrates resolving tension between extreme availability targets and strict budgetary caps.
routing_rationale: Real-world architecture requires negotiating trade-offs: when business availability goals exceed budget reality, architects present quantitative tiered options.

nodes.label: Demanded 99.999% SLA
nodes.detail: Stakeholder demands zero downtime under all circumstances across 3 continents.

nodes.label: Strict $1,500/Month Budget
nodes.detail: Budget ceiling is mathematically insufficient for multi-region Spanner + Interconnects.

nodes.label: Tiered Trade-Off Matrix
nodes.product: Option A vs Option B Analysis
nodes.detail: Presents Tier 1 (99.9% Regional Cloud SQL @ $800/mo) vs Tier 2 (99.999% Spanner @ $4,500/mo).

nodes.label: Approved Realistic Design
nodes.detail: Stakeholders align on Tier 1 Regional HA, saving $3,700/mo while meeting business goals.

steps.title: Conflict Formalization
steps.action: Architect constructs trade-off matrix demonstrating mathematical incompatibility of five-nines at low budget.
steps.why_traversal: Reframes subjective emotional debate into objective financial reality.

steps.title: Consensus Alignment
steps.action: Leadership signs off on Regional HA architecture with clear documented RTO/RPO expectations.
steps.why_traversal: Protects engineering team from unrealistic SLA commitments.

scenarios.label: Unspoken Assumption Causes Production Crisis
scenarios.root_cause: Architect silently built single-zone database to stay within budget without informing leadership.
scenarios.diverted_path: Zonal maintenance caused 20-minute outage; CEO furious at lack of 5-nines.
scenarios.blast_radius: Executive loss of trust in engineering.
scenarios.recovery: Always document SLA limitations explicitly in Architecture Decision Records signed by executive sponsors.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Simulates Compliance & Cost Trade-off Conflict: demonstrates resolving tension between extreme availability targets and strict budgetary caps.
